flashcard_questions.q: How is the rate of reaction defined?
flashcard_questions.a: The amount of product formed, or reactant used up, per unit of time.

flashcard_questions.q: Which equation gives the mean rate of a reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: Mean rate = amount of product formed ÷ time taken.

flashcard_questions.q: What are the units of rate when the volume of gas is measured?
Which apparatus is used to measure the volume of gas produced?
What does a steep line on a rate graph show?
What does a flat line on a rate graph show?
flashcard_questions.a: The reaction has finished, because a reactant is used up.

flashcard_questions.q: How do you find the rate at one point on a curved graph?
flashcard_questions.a: Draw a tangent at that point and find its gradient.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the activation energy of a reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: The minimum energy colliding particles need for a reaction to take place.

flashcard_questions.q: Besides enough energy, what else must colliding particles have?
flashcard_questions.a: The correct orientation, so bonds can break and new ones form.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does raising the temperature increase the rate of reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: Particles collide more often and more collisions reach the activation energy.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does raising the concentration increase the rate of reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: More reactant particles in the same volume collide more frequently.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does grinding a solid into powder increase the rate of reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: More surface is exposed, so more collisions happen at the same time.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a catalyst in a chemical reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: A substance that speeds up a reaction without being used up itself.

flashcard_questions.q: How does a catalyst increase the rate of reaction?
flashcard_questions.a: It provides an alternative pathway with a lower activation energy.

flashcard_questions.q: In the marble chip practical, which variables must be kept the same?
flashcard_questions.a: The mass of marble chips and the volume of acid.
